why: manual/manual.m3u declares tvg-resolution="1080" on the Zee Bangla fallback, and the verifier reads that declaration when a raw-TS route offers no manifest to measure. A declaration the project cannot check is a guess, so it was checked: the H.264 SPS was decoded straight from the transport stream.
conclusion: The declared 1080 is correct, so reading it is reading a fact rather than trusting a playlist. The same SPS explains why this route decodes nowhere: frame_mbs_only_flag=0 means interlaced, and combined with zero IDR frames no browser decoder can start on it. It is kept as a backup, not as the primary.
